description:
Equifax is seeking creative, high-energy and driven software engineers with hands-on development skills to work on a variety of meaningful projects. Our software engineering positions provide you the opportunity to join a team of talented engineers working with leading-edge technology. You are ideal for this position if you are a forward-thinking, committed, and enthusiastic software engineer who is passionate about technology. 


 What you’ll do 
 Main and first point of contact from business units for support, changes, and escalations.
 Build and test existing automation solutions according to standards and technical design, using best practices that are efficient, well-structured, maintainable, and easy to understand.
 Implement change requests with the guidance of Senior Solution Designer and RPA Tech Lead and maintain technical responsibility for high-quality project delivery according to change request timelines.
 Maintain solution documentation up to date, deliver on service level agreements and provide reports related to support metrics.
 Ensure the quality of components by performing thorough unit testing and code reviews mainly focusing on change requests or fixes.
 Coordinate and plan solutions and changes with business and technical teams.
 

 What experience you need  
 University degree in Computer Science or equivalent IT experience
 Proficient in English oral and written (B2+ level)
 6+ months of working experience in programming languages such as C#, VB.NET, or Python 
 6+ months of working experience in source code control management systems (e.g. SVN/Git, GitHub) 
 6+ months of working experience in Relational Databases (e.g. SQL Server, MySQL) 
 6+ months of working experience with RPA tools (UiPath) 
 
 
 What could set you apart 
 Certified in UiPath
 Certified in Cloud Technologies (GCP, AWS, Azure) or relevant experience 
 Eagerness to keep abreast of the latest technologies
 Knowledge in Agile Methodology and Machine Learning
 Familiar with any of the following topics/tools Cognitive Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Chatbots, Natural Language Processing
 Knowledge of self-contained, reusable, and testable modules and components
